title: An end date before the start date is accepted, with negative days
summary: A request whose end date is before its start date is saved instead of refused. Its day count is negative, so if a manager approves it the employee's balance goes up.
steps: Request leave from 15 March 2030 to 13 March 2030 (dates the wrong way round).
No error is shown; the request appears as pending with -1 days.

expected.text: The end date must be on or after the start date, and the request must contain at least one working day; otherwise HTTP 400 with a message, and nothing is saved.

actual: HTTP 201. The request is stored with days = -1 and status pending.

how.state: SELECT start_date, end_date, days FROM requests WHERE days < 1 → 2030-03-15, 2030-03-13, -1.
how.byDesignCheck: PRD R3 is explicit. Not by design.

hint: In createRequest, after checking the dates are valid, refuse with 400 when end < start, and (once AL-2 is fixed) when the working-day count is below 1. Do this before the balance check and the INSERT.
